sens_en: to exhaust, with all one's might
origine_fr: 立, debout, et 曷 qui donnait le son ; il se lit hé et ne garde que la fin. Au départ, c'est porter à bout de bras. Porter jusqu'au bout de ses forces : épuiser, 竭尽全力.
origine_en: 立, standing, and 曷, which gave the sound; it is read hé and keeps only the ending. At first it meant to lift and carry. Carrying to the end of your strength: to exhaust, 竭尽全力.

phrase.en: We will do our utmost to help you.
